name: Zen garden
description: A dry garden of raked sand and stones under a low moon. The sand is raked in straight furrows, and in rings round each of five stones: each stone is a part of the spectrum, and the rings round it deepen as its part sounds and travel slowly outwards on the music's clock. A stone lantern glows with the sound and lights the sand about it, the water in a stone basin rings on every beat, maple leaves drift down, and fireflies shine with the high notes.
